text: At three seventeen A.M., Maya got a text. From herself.
sub: At 3:17 a.m., Maya got a text… from herself.

text: Sent ten years from the future. It said: Don't open the door. It's not Mom.
sub: Sent ten years from the future. It said: “Don't open the door. It's not Mom.”

text: She ran to the window. Mom was outside, in the driveway. Waving.
sub: She ran to the window. Mom was outside, in the driveway… waving.

text: The handle turned. Her phone buzzed: Open the window. Let her in.
sub: The handle turned. Her phone buzzed: “Open the window. Let her in.”

text: The door flew open. It was Mom. The real one.
sub: The door flew open. It was Mom. The real one.

text: And outside the glass, holding a phone, was Maya.
sub: And outside the glass, holding a phone… was Maya.
